title: Battery Marcy Artist Activation
gallery_text: An activation project between a collaborator and I of a decaying WW2 military installation that was converted into a public space/gallery space for artist. The textures from decay were seen as an asset of the space and kept in stabilized condition asking the artist to work with rather than work against the site. This project was a rejection of military sites simply being restored to their now obsolete use but an attempt to transform them into community assets. By preserving the essence of the place, its history became integrated into community members’ daily lives.

answers.interest: I am interested in how the built environment impacts peoples emotions and behaviors. There are many existing models that simulate movement and I am curious on their structures, what informs them and potential gaps between how simulations are modeled and how people relate to the world.
answers.suggestions: Movement modeling, modeling behavior based off of and algorithms understanding
